# East Point Form & Label Inc.

> Family-owned label, packaging, and print brokerage based in Nova Scotia, Canada. Founded in 2001 by Paul Andriopoulos; run day-to-day since 2016 by his son Peter. Sources labels, folding cartons, flexible packaging, and commercial print through a network of Canadian manufacturing partners, serving businesses across Nova Scotia and Atlantic Canada.

## Services

- **Labels** — paper and film labels, digital and flexographic printing, a wide range of substrates, adhesives, and finishes, including freezer, moisture, heat, and temperature-resistant options.
- **Folding Cartons** — custom paperboard cartons in a range of board stocks, structural styles (tuck-end, sleeve, rigid, and more), and finishes.
- **Flexible Packaging** — stand-up pouches, flow wrap, stick packs, spout pouches, sachets, quad-seal pouches, rollstock, and related film formats.
- **Print** — business cards, brochures, postcards, business forms, booklets, envelopes, banners, and short-run digital print.

East Point is a brokerage, not a manufacturer — it acts as a single point of contact connecting customers with the right manufacturing partner for their job, handling sourcing, coordination, and quality end-to-end.
